messages.text: hi,  i just got my bs4.  It looks great.  It is currently up and running.  the dashboard on the web as well as the led on the miner say its running at 19TH.  However it is on stock settings and only running 250w 650 frequency and 1150 voltage.  while the miner says its running 19th my mining pool and my hashwatcher both say its only running at 9.7 TH  i haven't swapped the OS out to harlo yet because my mining tools like the standard os and i wanted to make sure it worked before changing the OS
Handing this to our technical specialist now.

only been running for about 30 minutes,  it doesn't show the different chips but i see these messages in the log file: E (863499) hashrate_monitor: respnse for invalid asic 4
E (863499) hashrate_monitor: respnse for invalid asic 6
Passing those log lines straight to our technical specialist.

Back with you on the order side, and I'm sorry you've been chasing this.

Good news on the substance: your BS-4 has been confirmed faulty, so you're not troubleshooting it any further. The return is with the team for final approval right now, and they'll confirm by email shortly with the next step. I can't open the return or send a label until that approval lands, so I don't want to promise one early.

Leave the miner on stock settings, or switch it off, whichever you prefer.
Before you go, one thing: what made you keep the stock OS rather than flash Harlo straight away?
we were troubleshooting and we decided to not change anything because 2 of the 4 asics were not working

That makes sense, good call keeping it untouched.

Earlier you mentioned your mining tools prefer the standard OS. What do those tools do that Harlo OS would get in the way of?
i have stratumos with stratmux that does ai routing of hashrate based on pools, hashrate, difficulty etc.

That's a neat setup, and useful to know. I'll pass that detail on with your case.

Thanks for taking the time, and for being patient through all the log digging. You'll get the confirmation on the return by email.
i made comments in discord under support for help and haven't heard back yet

You don't need Discord for this one. The fault is already confirmed on our side, so nothing hangs on a reply there.

Your return is with the team for final approval, and the confirmation comes to you by email. Nothing further is needed from you right now.
